author: first_agent
why: the second agent provenance review (another agent/goal_campaign_20261002/mast_recipe_provenance_20261003/review.md) and the organiser reply of 2026-10-02 (rule 3 bars MAST equilibrium data a team can score against itself offline, incl. labelled demo shots and derived material) make v7/v10 ineligible as new entries. v11 replaces every component the history records as demo-selected with a choice fixed here, before any v11 map exists, from machine engineering, physics or allowed DIII-D data.
exposure_disclosure: the author built v7 and has seen its demo checks and its public Development scores; v11 is therefore NOT a blinded clean room. Every choice below is fixed by the stated reason, without any MAST label, demo shot or score being read for it.

components.solenoid_row_share: 0.5, from engineering: Battaglia et al., UKAEA-CCFE-PR(19)34, p.13: MAST's solenoid has two parallel branches of alternating radial layers, so each turn carries half the feed current (the census of 656 rows = 4 layers x 164 confirms the layer count). Conditional on the exported column being the total feed current (as the dataset documents). The earlier demo-EFIT fit of the same number is disclosed.
components.tf_turns: 24, from engineering: MAST centre rod of 24 wedge conductors / 24 TF coils (Centre column design for the MAST Spherical Tokamak, OSTI 222445).
components.current_basis: REPLACED: the two-term minimal p' and FF' pair, each linear in normalised flux and zero at the boundary (R(1-x), (1-x)/R) - the conventional lowest-order magnetic-reconstruction profile model. The third (hollow-current) term of v7 is dropped.
components.density_gate: REPLACED: no density gate (MIN_DENSITY = 0). A frame is used when its temperature profile passes the unchanged channel/peak/pair requirements; the solver's own trust test (convergence, axis within 0.25 m of the Te peak) remains.
components.current_support: REPLACED: the vessel envelope (machine geometry, no erosion) minus every grid cell that contains a coil conductor centre (cell membership: |R-Rc| <= dR/2 and |Z-Zc| <= dZ/2). Current is further confined to the closed-flux region as before.
components.vertical_hold: REPLACED: the radial-field hold keeps the plasma current centroid at the machine midplane Z = 0 (the MAST shaping coil set is up-down symmetric), not at the Thomson laser plane.
components.numerics: RELAXATION 0.3, HEIGHT_GAIN 0.4, CONVERGED 2e-3, ITERATIONS 100, one attempt; TEMPERATURE_SHARES, EDGE_SHARE, SMOOTHING_LENGTH, MIN_CHANNELS, MIN_PEAK_EV, MIN_PAIRS, PAIR_TOLERANCE, AXIS_TOLERANCE, SELF_CELL unchanged from their single first setting (label-free per git history; disclosed). One attempt vs retry was a Development-score choice (allowed with disclosure).
components.q95_betaN: map_scalars as v7: PRESSURE_FACTOR 2.25 and the q95 routine calibrated on allowed DIII-D shots; TF turns 24 (above).
components.fallbacks: input-only: frames without a trusted solve take the nearest solved frame's current pattern scaled to their Ip; shots without any take the cohort mean pattern; scalar time filling as v7. Producer changed (this solver).

no_selection: v11 is built once for all 1206 public shots. No variant search; no MAST label, demo shot or score is used. Its public Development score, once returned, is recorded (allowed with disclosure) and does not change v11.
qa: official validator code (A/qa_archives.sh), finite float32 65x65, 1206 shots; smoke parity WS = ML350 on 2 shots before the full build.
pairing: DIII-D: the deployed 195-net archive 33105268 (or the D4c all-data archive if D4c is confirmed and built). Submission authorised by the entrant.
